title: A Different Approach to Preventing Thrombosis

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to perform a pragmatic randomized controlled trial to compare the use of low molecular weight heparin (LMWH, lovenox, enoxaparin) versus acetylsalicylic acid (ASA) for venous thromboembolism (VTE) prophylaxis in patients with high-risk lower extremity fractures.

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants With Treatment-related Bleeding Events as Assessed by the Need for Blood Transfusions and Procedures for Bleeding Complications After Ini. timeframe=90 days. VTE Prophylaxis With Enoxaparin 30mg BID=52; VTE Prophylaxis With Aspirin 81mg BID=53
